issues: The ledger verification code mismatches expected values causing CSV verification failures: In __tests__/acceptance/m11.test.ts, the test expects the verification line to contain "headHash=" but generateCsv produces a line with "# verification: entries=..., headHash=..., code=...". The test parses the line with a regex expecting "headHash=([0-9a-f]{64})" which fails, resulting in an empty headHash and causing the verification code comparison to be incorrect. This also leads to mismatched headHash values in the assert for export.created entries where the test expects data.headHash to equal ledger[ledger.length - 1].hash, but appendEntryForExport sets headHash in data to the hash of the new entry, then the test compares it to the same entry's hash, causing a mismatch. Additionally, verifyExportCode returns headHash from entry.data.headHash (which is set to the entry's own hash) but the test expects it to be the previous hash, causing laterChanges checks to fail. Also, the ledger encryption test (R13) reads raw ledger storage via rawStore.getItem('ledger'), but the Store implementation does not store a 'ledger' key; ledger entries are stored encrypted via store.set('ledger', entries) which encrypts the array, but the mock raw store does not encrypt, so the test may not be valid. Finally, the backup restore verification calls verifyLedger with only the store, but verifyLedger expects both store and optional ledger data; the implementation signature is verifyLedger(store) while the restoreBackup passes ledger array incorrectly. These mismatches cause multiple test failures.

feedback": "Adjust generateCsv to match the verification line format expected by tests, ensure export.created entries store headHash correctly, and fix verifyExportCode logic to return the proper previous hash and laterChanges boolean. Also, revise ledger encryption handling in tests or implement a proper raw encrypted storage mock. Update verifyLedger signature and restoreBackup usage to align with expectations. Once these logic and format issues are resolved, re-run tests."
